mapper.select: SELECT n.*, p.province_name, c.city_name FROM node_info n LEFT JOIN province p ON n.province_code = p.province_code LEFT JOIN city c ON n.city_code = c.city_code WHERE n.id = #{id}

SELECT n.*, p.province_name, c.city_name FROM node_info n LEFT JOIN province p ON n.province_code = p.province_code LEFT JOIN city c ON n.city_code = c.city_code WHERE n.node_type = #{nodeType} AND n.status = 1 AND n.province_code = #{provinceCode} AND n.city_code = #{cityCode} ORDER BY n.node_code
SELECT MONTH(create_time) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM node_info WHERE create_time >= MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AND create_time < MAKEDATE(#{year} + 1, 1) GROUP BY MONTH(create_time)

SELECT p.province_name AS provinceName, COUNT(n.id) AS count FROM node_info n LEFT JOIN province p ON n.province_code = p.province_code WHERE n.province_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.province_code, p.province_name
SELECT node_type AS nodeType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM node_info GROUP BY node_type
